name: video_audio_mix
description: Lays an existing audio creation over a video and mixes the two tracks. Free — nothing is generated, so use it to attach a track `audio_tts` / `audio_music_generate` already produced. Volumes are 0-100 per track. To GENERATE the audio instead → `video_music` or `video_soundfx`. Then `creations_show`.

audioCreationIdentifier.description: Completed owned audio creation to lay over it. A video creation resolves to its extracted audio track.

audioVolume.description: Volume of the added track, 0-100. Default 100.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation. Max 200 MB.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

muteVideo.description: Silence the clip's own audio entirely.

videoVolume.description: Volume of the clip's own audio, 0-100. Default 100.
